name: Asana
one_liner: Asana provides a RESTful API for accessing and manipulating work data, plus an official MCP server for AI integrations.
auth_notes: OAuth is recommended for apps that act on behalf of users.
access_notes: You can generate a personal access token from the Asana developer console.

evidence.snippet: If you build an app, and the app needs to perform actions on behalf of users (e.g., getting data from Asana or making changes within Asana), you should use OAuth.
You can generate a personal access token from the Asana developer console.
The Asana API is a RESTful interface
Get started with the API and make your first request
Asana offers a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server
Set your distribution to “any workspace”, then follow the instructions on the Developer Console > Submit for Review page.
